newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch NAM says made encouraging gas find.
newsitem.headline: Dutch NAM says made encouraging gas find.

text.p: Dutch gas Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) said on Wednesday it had found a reserve of "a few billion cubic metres" of gas on the southern Dutch coast.
NAM will evaluate whether the gas, which is some three kilometres below ground, can be exploited.

If it decides to do so, it must find another location to begin drilling. The borehole in Gravenzande is located on the site of a former car park and NAM only had permission to make test drills before restoring the site to its previous condition.
NAM is jointly owned by Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon Group.
